fields.label: Webhook Rate Limit (per minute, per caller IP)
fields.description: The number of deliveries accepted from one address in a minute. Past the cap the provider is asked to back off and retries, so nothing is lost. 0 uses the default of 600.

fields.label: Template Rate Caps (manual sends, per lead)

fields.description: The most templates a rep may send one patient by hand in an hour. Blank allows 5; 0 removes the limit.
fields.label: Template Cap / Hour

fields.description: The most templates a rep may send one patient by hand in a day, so a patient cannot be messaged all day within the hourly limit. Blank allows 10; 0 removes the limit.
fields.label: Template Cap / Day
